facts.fact: The Public Finance Management Reforms Division director confirmed that 19 councils use the PETRA financial management system, which suffers server downtime, though the committee chair says only one or two officials can actually access it.
The PFMRD director said 19 councils currently use PETRA; no total number of councils is given.

SLE.note: PETRA is a financial management system; the text does not say councils record payers and payments of their own revenue in it.
